profile_text.body:
The website associated with this company, dexus.com, carries text describing Dexus, which the site describes as an Australasian real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development business with four decades of experience. The site says Dexus manages a multi-billion dollar portfolio and combines local insight with expertise in infrastructure and real estate. It cites Atlassian Central in Sydney reaching a full height of more than 180 metres, and a redundant Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds. The site identifies Dexus as ASX: DXS and states that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

The held facts, by contrast, identify the company as DXC Technology Co, a for profit public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, trading under the ticker DXC, with CIK 0001688568. The harvested site text does not describe DXC Technology Co, so the two sets of material do not match.

No products and no MCP servers are recorded for the company, and the cases list is empty. Its recorded legal exposure is in Virginia, with a count of 152.
